WHAMMO.Title: Warhammer Battle HUD
WHAMMO.Failed: That did not work. See the console (F12).

Settings.OnlyEquippedHint: Put-away ranged weapons move to the small gear group.
Settings.ShowGearHint: A small group of icons for equipping melee weapons and shields with one click.
Settings.LowAmmoHint: The count turns amber at this number or below.
Settings.ShowActionsHint: Tabs above the hotbar with the character's tests, weapons, spells and conditions.
Settings.ActionsOnlyEquippedHint: Player characters show only equipped weapons and armour. NPCs and creatures always show everything.
Settings.BlindOnShiftHint: Holding Shift while clicking a test in the panel makes it a Blind GM roll.
Settings.SkipDialogByDefaultName: Skip the roll dialog by default
Settings.SkipDialogByDefaultHint: Tests from the panel roll straight away; hold Alt to see the dialog. When off, Alt skips it.
Settings.ShowUnrollableTraitsHint: Also list traits that have no test (clicking posts them to chat).
Settings.ShowTokenTestsHint: Quick tests with their values on the token's HUD, for anyone who owns the character.

WHFRAMES.Title: Warhammer Battle HUD
WHFRAMES.Hint: Click: target. Double-click: go to the token. Right-click: open the sheet.
WHFRAMES.NoToken: {name} has no token on this scene.

Settings.PlayersSeeAllHint: When off, players see only the health bars of characters they do not own, without numbers, resources or conditions.

Notify.ItemMissing: This item no longer exists on the actor.
Notify.EffectMissing: This effect script is no longer available.
Notify.ActionFailed: The action failed. See the console (F12) for details.
